description: Zdravo, mi smo Morioh Works. Izrađujemo razne vrste igara, i ovo nam je 3 hackathon. Na Global Game Jam koji je bio organizovan u Podgorici, osvojili smo 3. mjesto. Uglavnom koristimo Godot za development i pravimo primarno 2D igre.
summary: Orbital Architect is a 2D orbital-mechanics game that makes real mission design playable. You build a spacecraft from tanks, engines and sciene parts, then plan and fly the burns to the Moon, Mars, 16 Psyche, etc. It uses NASA/JPL ephemerides, RK4 and Tsiolkovsky mass loss so fuel, mass and timing matter. A five misson campaign sits alongside a sandbox, contract board, shareable custom missions and a fight school that ends in a lunar landing. At the end of each mission there are debriefs which score your budget, remaining propellant and explain the science behind each target. It matters because mission design is usually locked behind specialist tools, this puts the trade-offs in your hands and lets students and hobbyists learn by flying
details:
Orbit Architect is a 2D orbital-mechanics and spacecraft-engineering game. You design a spacecraft, plan the burns and progate, and fl the mission all the way from lunar orbit to Saturn.

How it works: In the hangar you place parts on a grid: tanks, engines, power, science, comms, heat shields. There are 3 rules which are exactly 1 command core, every part connected to it, and the engine touching a tank. Mass, cost and delta-v from the rocket equation, so propellant and engine choice decide what a mission can do. In the flight the ship is integrated with RK4 through the summed gravity of twelve bodies, using JPL Keplerian ephemerides and adaptive timesteps. Every flight ends with a debrief that scores objectives, budget and remaining fuel.

Benefit and impact: It makes mission design something you actually experience than read about. For example: why departure timing matters, what gravity assists helps with, why a capture costs what it costs. It also runs on ordinary laptops, needs no GPU, and comes in English and Montenegrin.

Tools: Godot 4.7 and GDScript. Most of the content is stored in JSON, Data from JPL Solar System Dynamics and NASA NSSDCA. CC0 sound effects by Kenney, music by Eric Matyas, AI voicelines from Fish Audio S2.1 Pro free.

Creative choices: 2D was chosen for ease of development, although the first idea was 3D. Aswell as the campaign, there is a deterministic procedural contract board, a mision builder, and even free build.

Trade-offs considered: Accuracy VS playability, since the entire idea is for the game to be as accurate as possible which sacrifices playability a bit due to difficulty. There are some auto tools implemented however to help more casual players which still explain what they did and why, aswell as hints. Performance was a big thing too and we ended up using cached epheremis tables and throttled prediction.
